reviewer: Native GPT-6 Astra max author; driving Astra reviewed early and corrected exact-GLB views
lead_visual_review: Updated front, side, back and motion sheet accepted as a coherent studio candidate on 2026-09-23. Exact Tom art review remains pending.
visual_findings: Plain cream eyelid plates, tired glass eyes and worn ochre beak; no lashes, makeup or glamour costume.
Cream shoulder caps enclose the old mechanisms; broad padded body, softer hem and fuller knees retain the reference silhouette.
Simple short burgundy apron follows the belly, with a flat club token patch and plain rear ties.
The microphone is visibly held by a wing grip at rest and rises outside the face silhouette during the attack warning.
Attack contact at 1.25 s is visible from front, side and gameplay-scale strip.
The held defeat is a shallow failed curtsy with both feet planted and microphone retained.
No visible face/wing/prop collision or floor intersection in inspected rest, warning, contact, recoil or held-defeat views. Dark mechanical overlaps at articulation gaps are intentional.
interpretations: No reference pixels used as a texture. The cloth and molded surfaces use an original compact procedural pigment atlas.
The construction-sheet microphone is held low in a real rest grip rather than floating as a detached illustration inset.
Feather panels and surface repairs are simplified for the mobile triangle ceiling.
limitations: Real Chromium WebGL with SwiftShader was inspected; physical iPhone/iPad Safari and PC performance acceptance remain later gates.
The clip provides a microphone gesture only; no sound-ring hazard or encounter has been implemented.
Studio candidate only; no gameplay mapping or owner-art approval.
